jobs.occupation: Head of Analog Design (m/f/d) - Executive (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.description:
Company Description

In September 2025, AUMOVIO emerged as a spin-off from Continental’s former Automotive group sector and has since established itself as an independent technology company. The company offers a broad portfolio for safe, exciting, connected and autonomous mobility, including sensor solutions, displays, brake and comfort systems as well as extensive expertise in software, architecture platforms and advanced driver assistance systems for software-defined vehicles. In fiscal year 2025, AUMOVIO generated sales of € 18.5 billion. Headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, AUMOVIO has around 82,000 employees at more than 80 locations worldwide.

Job Description

We are seeking an executive leader (m/f/d) with deep expertise in analog and mixed-signal integrated circuit design to lead a strategically important global organization. In this role, you will drive innovation, technology leadership, and organizational excellence while shaping next-generation semiconductor solutions for demanding automotive applications.

As Head of Analog Design (m/f/d), you will lead a global organization of highly skilled engineers across multiple locations worldwide. You will be responsible for defining and executing the organization's analog design strategy, ensuring world-class designs, engineering excellence and enabling sustainable business growth through innovative semiconductor solutions.

Key responsibilities include:

- Defining and executing the long-term Analog Design strategy aligned with business objectives
- Leading, mentoring, and developing leaders, and engineering teams across global sites
- Overseeing the complete analog IC development lifecycle from concept through production readiness
- Driving technology innovation, development excellence, and continuous improvement initiatives
- Establishing and maintaining strategic partnerships with design houses, universities, foundries, OSATs, and ecosystem partners
- Managing budgets, resource allocation, capability development, and organizational growth
- Influencing product portfolio decisions, technology roadmaps, and business case development
- Representing the company in industry forums, conferences, and strategic technology networks

Qualifications

- Academic Degree in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Physics, or comparable qualification
- Long term experience in semiconductor and IC development
- Experience managing substantial budgets, resources, and organizational growth
- Proven track record of bringing complex semiconductor products to mass production and building high-performing engineering organizations
- Significant leadership experience within international R&D organizations
- Demonstrated success leading diverse, geographically distributed teams
- Recognized technology and people leader (m/f/d) with deep expertise in analog design and semiconductor technologies
- Business fluent English language skills (written and spoken)
- Strong strategic thinking and business acumen
- Outstanding communication, stakeholder management, and executive leadership capabilities

Applications from severely handicapped people are welcome.

Additional Information

- Next to the interesting daily work the region around Regensburg is offering a high recreational value and quality of life.
- Profit from extensive benefits at the location such as different canteens and cafeterias, a continuing education and training, health management, physiotherapy and much more.
- We offer an attractive salary as well as the possibility of hybrid and cross-border mobile work.
- For an improved work-life balance we support you with various initiatives for a better compatibility of family and career such as flexible work time model, part-time option, sabbatical, etc.
- You can expect a highly motivated team as well as diverse topics and projects in the global environment of the automotive industry.
- We are promoting lifelong Learning combined with personal and professional development.
- You are looking for an individual working time model? We support part-time work.

You would like to learn more about our additional services? Click here (https://www.aumovio.com/en/career/why-join-us.html) .

Ready to take your career to the next level? The future of mobility isn’t just anyone’s job. ​Make it yours! Join AUMOVIO. Own What’s Next.

As a Senior Consultant / Manager (f|m|x), you advise our clients in
the banking sector and financial services industry on complex topics

situation, identify new requirements early on and, together with your
team, develop tailored solutions – from the initial idea all the way

development of your clients’ liquidity risk management, enabling
well‑founded decision-making. You assume subject-matter
responsibility, manage collaboration within the project and shape the
content development of our consulting approaches. Your tasks: You
support and lead exciting (sub-)projects at banks and financial
services providers in their liquidity and market price risk
management, taking full responsibility – from gap analyses and the
design of client-specific solutions through to implementation. You
develop integrated management approaches for liquidity and market
price risk, bank-wide liquidity risk stress tests and quantitative
modeling frameworks, for example for risk measurement or interest
rate, margin and liquidity cash flow analyses. In addition, you design
methodological frameworks (for example in the ILAAP context) and
develop solutions to implement IRRBB and CSRBB requirements as well as
net interest income (NII) simulations. As part of your role, you also
ensure the effective integration of regulatory requirements, for
instance with respect to ICAAP and ILAAP as well as IRRBB and CSRBB.
You take responsibility for your own deliverables and those of your
team and proactively advance topics. With your strong team orientation
and professionalism, you foster trust-based collaboration – both
within the team and with our clients. You also mentor junior
colleagues, developing both their professional capabilities and
personal strengths, and thus contribute to the team’s growth. You
actively help shape the ongoing enhancement of our consulting
portfolio, identify relevant market potential at an early stage and
derive concrete ideas from it. With your expertise, you support the
development of new offerings and the acquisition of new client
mandates. Your skills: You hold a degree in mathematics, (business)
informatics, physics, statistics or economics, ideally supplemented by
certifications such as FRM or CFA. You have at least three years of
professional experience in consulting or the financial industry.
Proven involvement in leading bank-specific implementation projects in
liquidity and market price risk management is an advantage, and
initial exposure to specialist leadership (for example coordinating
team members) is also part of your profile. You have a solid
understanding of liquidity and market price risk management as well as
the ICAAP and ILAAP frameworks. You confidently apply your analytical
and quantitative skills in modeling and data analysis; programming
skills in Python or R are explicitly welcome. You are familiar with
relevant European and German regulatory requirements, including EBA
Guidelines on IRRBB and CSRBB, SREP requirements, ICAAP and ILAAP.
Initial experience in dealing professionally with external audits is a
plus. You work and think in a structured and solution-oriented manner
and communicate clearly. A client- and team-oriented way of working
comes naturally to you, especially when assuming responsibility within
a team and engaging effectively with different people and situations.
You have excellent command of the German language (at least C1 level,

least B2 level, fluent), both written and spoken. #LI-LARA #LI-hybrid

jobs.description:
Job available in 4 locations: Berlin, Remote, Leipzig, Halle

Work Schedule
Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions
Office

Job Description

Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

The Clinical Diagnostics Division (CDD) provides innovative diagnostic solutions across selected in vitro diagnostics (IVD) market segments and has been a trusted partner to the IVD industry for more than 40 years.

Our portfolio includes solutions for drugs-of-abuse testing, therapeutic drug monitoring, quality control, sepsis diagnosis, prenatal screening and more. In addition, CDD offers advanced laboratory instrumentation and high-throughput automation solutions for a wide range of clinical laboratory environments.

Our products and solutions are delivered through direct sales, regional distributors and OEM partnerships.

Location:

Field-based / Remote within the territory - Eastern/ Central Germany
Ideally based in e.g. Halle, Leipzig or Berlin

Discover Impactful Work
Join our Clinical Customer Development team as a Clinical Customer Development Specialist and support the targeted clinical use of Procalcitonin (PCT) and other innovative biomarkers.

In this field-based role, you will lead clinical market development across your territory and increase awareness, acceptance and sustainable adoption of our biomarkers through targeted engagement with healthcare professionals, clinical education and development activities. In doing so, you will support the diagnosis and management of bacterial infections and sepsis, as well as antimicrobial stewardship initiatives, and contribute to advancing biomarker-guided clinical decision-making.

You will take ownership of clinical market development within your territory, with the goal of increasing demand, acceptance and sustainable clinical adoption of our biomarkers. Your focus will be on clinical education, stakeholder engagement and account development, while commercial contracting and sales execution remain with our License Partners.

A Day in the Life:
You will lead clinical account development across hospitals and healthcare institutions within your territory and build strong, sustainable relationships with clinicians, laboratory professionals and healthcare decision-makers in areas such as Internal Medicine, Paediatrics, Infectious Diseases, Emergency Medicine, Critical Care and Antimicrobial Stewardship teams.

You will identify the objectives and clinical challenges of healthcare professionals and translate these insights into targeted educational and development activities. This includes supporting the implementation of biomarker-guided clinical pathways, hospital protocols and antimicrobial stewardship programs, as well as delivering clinical education through discussions, presentations and workshops.

What to expect:

- Drive clinical demand and adoption of Procalcitonin (PCT) and other innovative biomarkers.
- Engage healthcare professionals, clinical users and decision-makers across relevant medical specialties.
- Analyze and prioritize accounts with high clinical development potential, identify relevant stakeholders and develop account-specific strategies to increase clinical acceptance and adoption.
- Build strong, sustainable relationships with key clinical stakeholders and decision-makers.
- Support the implementation of biomarker-guided clinical pathways, hospital protocols and antimicrobial stewardship programs.
- Deliver clinical education through discussions, presentations and workshops.
- Develop account strategies together with our License Partners, align clinical development activities and support joint customer activities where appropriate.
- Act as a scientific and clinical partner and actively drive market development without direct sales responsibility.
- Work closely with Medical Affairs, Marketing and other Commercial teams.
- Represent Thermo Fisher Scientific at relevant events and scientific congresses.
- Contribute to territory growth through increased clinical adoption and systematic account development.Ensure complete and up-to-date documentation of relevant account and activity information in Salesforce (SFDC).

Keys to Success:
Education

- Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Chemistry, Biology or a related scientific field; an advanced scientific or clinical degree is an advantage.

Experience

- 3+ years of relevant experience in healthcare, diagnostics or a related environment.
- Experience in in vitro diagnostics, biomarkers, or clinical areas such as Critical Care, Infectious Diseases, Emergency Medicine, sepsis or Antimicrobial Stewardship is an advantage.
- Experience engaging clinical users and healthcare decision-makers.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

- Ability to understand and communicate scientific and clinical content.
- Strong communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.
- Confident and persuasive engagement with medical decision-makers at different seniority levels, with the ability to conduct credible clinical discussions, constructively challenge established approaches and initiate change.
- Strong analytical and organizational capabilities.
- Strong initiative, influencing skills and results orientation, with the ability to identify clinical development opportunities early and systematically advance them.
- Ability to build lasting relationships with clinical stakeholders and business partners.
- Ability to work independently and effectively in a cross-functional matrix organization.
- Proficiency with CRM systems, preferably Salesforce, and Microsoft Office.
- Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory (>50%).
- Fluent German and strong English communication skills.

Benefits:
We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits. Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation!

Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Watch as our colleagues explain 5 reasons to work with us. As one team of 100,000+ colleagues, we share a common set of values - Integrity, Intensity, Innovation and Involvement - working together to accelerate research, solve complex scientific challenges, drive technological innovation and support patients in need.

#StartYourStory at Thermo Fisher Scientific, where diverse experiences, backgrounds and perspectives are valued.

Apply today! http://jobs.thermofisher.com (http://jobs.thermofisher.com/)
